'''Acid-beet salad''' was a [[Salad/Legends|salad]] dish that included as ingredients the [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] known as [[acid-beet]]s,<ref name="DaD" /> which were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|9|acid-beet}}</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] owned by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served the [[Salad/Legends|salad]] as a side dish for 3.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster himself considered the dish delicious.<ref name="DaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Acid-beet salad was featured in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
